routes.title: Home
routes.description: Public landing page. Shows sign-in status read from the local access token and offers logout when signed in.

states.name: signed-out
states.mockSummary: No API calls; static view with no mock data.

routes.title: Sign in
routes.description: Public login form. Requests a one-time code by email; the response is always generic so it never reveals whether the email belongs to an account.

states.name: error
states.mockSummary: Fills 1 field(s), then submits the form; POST /api/auth/request-login fails with a "unavailable" error.

states.name: idle
states.mockSummary: No API calls; static view with no mock data.

routes.title: Enter your code
routes.description: Second step of the login flow. Only reachable with a pending email carried over in memory from /login; a fresh deep link redirects back.

states.name: idle
states.mockSummary: Visits /login, then fills 1 field(s), then submits the form; POST /api/auth/request-login returns 204 No Content.

routes.title: Your profile
routes.description: Protected page behind the _authenticated layout. Shows the caller's email and lets them edit display_name via PUT /api/profile.

states.name: error
states.mockSummary: Fills 1 field(s), then submits the form; GET /api/profile returns mock data (email, display_name); PUT /api/profile fails with a "unavailable" error.
